column1: # - [Header] is free-form metadata for humans; the parser ignores it.
#     Recommended row: sequencing-host = the workstation that ran MinKNOW
#     (fastq_dir may point to a NAS copy; the path then does not tell which workstation it was).
#     fastq_dir : absolute path to MinKNOW's fastq_pass directory AS SEEN FROM THE HOST RUNNING ont-merge.sh
#                 <sample-id-folder> is the sample ID given to MinKNOW; no_sample_id if none was given.
#     ligation         -> barcode-number is "none" (or empty); exactly one row
# - Lines beginning with # and blank lines are ignored.
